protocol: Three-arm representation distillation on the challenge-connectivity-disjoint 78k external corpus. Arm 1 learns only Jeremy raw600 coordinates and within-batch cosine geometry from random initialization. Arm 2 starts from the strongest owned continuous joint checkpoint and combines its external 59-task masked MSE with distillation. Arm 3 starts from Jeremy message-passing weights and combines the same external task loss with a weak Jeremy anchor. All arms use one raw600 embedding and the same target-specific fixed LightGBM OOF readout.
